description: Reg. § 1.453-12(d) Example 1: § 1250 property sold for $10,000 in ten equal annual installments; cost $5,000, straight-line depreciation $3,000; '$8000 of section 1231 gain ... $3000 is ... unrecaptured section 1250 gain. The gain on each installment payment is $800.' Table — Taxed at 25%: 800, 800, 800, 600; Remaining to be taxed at 25%: 2200, 1400, 600. Fourth year (three $1,000 payments before): 'Of the $800 of gain on the fourth payment ... $600 is taxed at 25 percent and the remaining $200 is taxed at 20 percent.'
